title: [NatWest demo] Payments OTel - api-gateway 5xx rate breach
description:
Reads OTel server spans on the api-gateway (index=otel_traces sourcetype=otel:traces service.name=api-gateway) and computes the HTTP 5xx rate over the last 5 minutes. Fires one ITSI notable when the rate exceeds 5% with at least 30 total requests in the window. Steady-state demo traffic sits around ~1% 5xx (synthetic fraud rejections + intentional SWIFT/CHAPS error noise), so 5% means a real cascade is in progress. Pairs symptom-side with every chaos scenario that causes downstream errors to bubble up to the gateway: gateway-timeout-squeeze (drops downstream timeout to 0.5s), kill-service (any backend scaled to 0), postgres-outage (ledger JDBC failures bubble back as 500s), redis-outage (sanctions/fraud cache lookups fail), kafka-outage (settlement chain breaks). The chaos audit notable for the inject still fires from chaos_injection_audit; this search is the independent SIEM-side confirmation that the symptom landed - the demo's value story is 'detection happened from spans, not just from the chaos audit log'. Service is set to 'Payment Services' so the notable rolls up under the same L2 tile as the gateway in the ITSI tree.

The dedupe key (cohort_key) is bound to the 5-minute bin so re-runs of this scheduled search inside the same window collapse to one notable. The cron is */2 to keep latency between symptom and Episode low while staying well inside Splunk's default scheduled-search budget.
search: index=otel_traces sourcetype="otel:traces" "service.name"=api-gateway kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER" "attributes.http.status_code"=* | bin _time span=5m | eval is_5xx = if(tonumber('attributes.http.status_code') >= 500, 1, 0) | stats sum(is_5xx) AS errors, count AS total BY _time | where total >= 30 AND errors > 0 | eval error_rate = round(errors / total, 4) | where error_rate >= 0.05 | eval severity = case(error_rate >= 0.30, "6", error_rate >= 0.15, "5", true(), "4") | eval service = "Payment Services" | eval pct = round(error_rate * 100, 1) | eval title = "api-gateway 5xx rate " . pct . "% (" . errors . " / " . total . " requests)" | eval source = "Splunk ES - payments OTel" | eval cohort_key = "gateway_5xx:" . strftime(_time, "%Y%m%d%H%M") | eval description = title . " - independent symptom detection that the payment chain is degraded. Cross-check with chaos_injection_audit notables in the same Episode; if a chaos is active this is the on-call confirmation. If no chaos audit, treat as a genuine production regression." | table _time, severity, service, title, source, errors, total, error_rate, pct, cohort_key, description
action.itsi_event_generator.param.title: $result.title$
